reviewGuide.title: How does a release review work?
reviewGuide.features: Choose what should work. Features describe user or business outcomes, such as receiving a partner webhook.
reviewGuide.checks: Define how to verify each feature. A check states the expected behavior and how to test it.
reviewGuide.results: Record what happened. A result belongs to that check and this exact version, with an observation or supporting link.
reviewGuide.decision: Review the unresolved items. A release owner decides whether to approve or hold the release.
reviewGuide.optional: Screens and architecture add context when needed. Components are the services, APIs, jobs, and databases behind features. Start with one feature; AI is optional.
